SELECT s.id AS seatId, s.venue_hall_id AS venueHallId,
s.section_name AS sectionName, s.floor AS floor, s.row_name AS rowName, s.seat_number AS seatNumber,
s.seat_type AS seatType
FROM v1_seats s
LEFT JOIN v1_performance_seats ps ON ps.seat_id = s.id AND ps.performance_id = #{performanceId}
WHERE s.venue_hall_id = #{venueHallId}
AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ps.id IS NULL
ORDER BY s.floor ASC, s.section_name ASC, s.row_name ASC, s.id ASC
